label: prf:categorical-proton-exists
title: Proof of existence of the categorical proton
html:
Proof. Proof of existence of the categorical proton

Proof. The Borromean braid \mathcal{B}_3 = (\sigma_0 \sigma_1^{-1})^3 is a concrete element of the braid group B_3, and thus of the Hecke algebra H_3(q) via the standard representation. Typed crossings for the partition (\mathfrak{u}, \mathfrak{u}, \mathfrak{d}) and the Hopf-link gluon stabiliser L_- = \sigma_1 \sigma_0 are likewise elements of H_3(q). Their product reduces via Gröbner--Shirshov to a canonical Hecke normal form. LP-dual feasibility verifies the non-negativity constraint G x[\gamma] \ge 0 at every intermediate step. Consequently, the categorical proton \mathfrak{p} exists as a well-defined, LP-stable element.
